text:
sam: Heads up — we're provisioning 120 new GPU nodes in eu-west-1 for the inference-canary fleet next week. Need to request increases for Elastic IPs and ENI limits before Friday. Estimated peak: 950 EIPs (for external nat per node) and ~3k ENIs.

anika: Are EIPs per instance required? could we use NAT gateways / prefix delegation to reduce EIP count?

sam: Some of the pools require public IPs for model cache updates and external metrics endpoints. We evaluated NAT but latency jitter and single-NAT bottleneck not acceptable for canaries.

kevin: Also watch ENI-per-subnet and IPs-per-ENI limits. If we hit ENI caps, nodes will fail to attach. Which instance types?

sam: p4d.24xlarge and a mix of g5dn.12xlarge. Expected ENIs: 4 per p4d and 3 per g5dn. totals in calc below.

juan: Drop a summary we can paste into the cloud support ticket. include account IDs and desired new quotas.

sam:
```
Account: 123456789012
Region: eu-west-1
Current quotas: EIPs 500, ENIs 1000, IPv6 prefixes 0
Requested: EIPs -> 2000, ENIs -> 5000, IPv6 /56 prefix -> yes, VPCs per region -> 50
Reason: onboarding dedicated GPU pools for inference-canary + staging. Timeline: Feb 12 - Mar 1
```

anika: Suggest requesting IPv6 /56 delegation so we can avoid EIP per node long-term. Also ask for increase in 'IPv4 addresses per VPC' and 'subnets per VPC' if possible.

kevin: Cost note — EIPs that are allocated but unused are billed. We'll only allocate as we create nodes, but if quota granted we won't pre-allocate unless needed.

cloudops-bot: Support ticket opened with AWS: 04561234567. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/04561234567

juan: @sam can you add precise numbers for ENIs and EIPs by instance count? I'll escalate once you post.

sam: Updated calc: 120 p4d nodes * 4 ENIs = 480 ENIs, 80 g5dn * 3 = 240 ENIs => total ~720 ENIs. Peak EIPs assume 1 per node => 200 EIPs buffer + 750 for future -> request 2000 to be safe.

anika: +1 for asking IPv6. Also ask for 'Elastic IPs per Region' and 'Private IPv4 pool size' increases.

kevin: If AWS pushes back, alternate plan: split pools across 2 regions and use cross-region routing for cache updates.

sam: Thanks — will paste final into ticket. If approved, we'll schedule pool creation next Tuesday. :thumbsup:

cloudops-bot: Case 04561234567 status: Pending - Customer response. AWS replied requesting justification for /56; provide architecture doc.

juan: I'll attach the diagram.

sam: done — attached diagram and perf rationale. pinging here when AWS responds.
